lines.zh: 冰下的水很冷，我游得很快。
lines.en: The water under the ice is cold, and I swim fast.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像暴雪，划开冷水。
lines.en: My fins cut the cold water like a blizzard.

lines.zh: 冰面在头顶，光是一块块白的。
lines.en: Ice roofs the water and the light comes in white chunks.

lines.zh: 两条一起，我们追着鱼群跑。
lines.en: The two of us chase the shoals together.

lines.zh: 冷水让我浑身发热。
lines.en: Cold water sets my whole body burning warm.

lines.zh: 我撞开浮冰，碎屑沉下去。
lines.en: I break through drift ice and the chips sink.

lines.zh: 我的身体太沉，转弯要很久。
lines.en: My body is heavy, so turns take a long time.

lines.zh: 冻洋里没什么吃的，我一直在游。
lines.en: The frozen ocean holds little food; I keep swimming.

lines.zh: 雪花落进水里，马上就没影了。
lines.en: Snow falls into the water and vanishes at once.

lines.zh: 我顺着冰缘走，那里鱼多。
lines.en: I follow the ice edge, where fish gather.

lines.zh: 一记尾摆，我窜出十几身位。
lines.en: A single tail beat shoots me a dozen lengths on.

lines.zh: 同伴跟在我后面，喘着水。
lines.en: My companion follows behind, pushing water.

lines.zh: 水越往深处越黑，也更冷。
lines.en: The deeper it goes, the darker and colder.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰底的蓝影游。
lines.en: I travel along the blue shadow under the ice.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰层游，冷得发麻。
lines.en: I swim under the ice until the cold numbs me.

lines.zh: 前面的鱼群散了，我追过去。
lines.en: The school ahead scatters; I give chase.

lines.zh: 我悬在冰下，慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: I hover beneath the ice, tail swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 我的鳍很宽，冷风一吹就张开。
lines.en: My fins are broad and spread at the cold wind.

lines.zh: 冰在水上咔咔作响，很远处也是。
lines.en: The ice cracks and groans, even far away.

lines.zh: 我呼出的水汽变成了小白点。
lines.en: My breath leaves as small white specks.

lines.zh: 我身上还有一点暖，这是本事。
lines.en: I keep a little warmth; that is my trick.

lines.zh: 一只海豹在冰上，我不上去。
lines.en: A seal rests on the ice; I stay below.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着雪落进水里的地方。
lines.en: I watch where the snow melts into water.

lines.zh: 这片冷水我游了一辈子。
lines.en: I have swum this cold water all my life.

lines.zh: 同伴在旁边，我们谁都不动。
lines.en: My companion is beside me and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上结了一层薄霜。
lines.en: A thin frost has formed on my scales.

lines.zh: 我在等一小群鱼游过来。
lines.en: I am waiting for a small shoal to come by.

lines.zh: 冰底下的世界是蓝的，也是静的。
lines.en: The world beneath the ice is blue and silent.

lines.zh: 冷到骨头里，可我不怕冷。
lines.en: It chills to the bone, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我把尾鳍慢慢放平，歇一会。
lines.en: I level my tail fin slowly and rest a while.

lines.zh: 你从冰洞往下看，脸是白的。
lines.en: You look down through an ice hole, face pale.

lines.zh: 我的鳍对着你，像一片风雪。
lines.en: My fins face you like a squall of snow.

lines.zh: 你敢下水吗？这里冷得咬人。
lines.en: Dare you come in? This cold bites.

lines.zh: 你在冰上走动，声音传得很清楚。
lines.en: You walk on the ice and every step carries.

lines.zh: 我绕着你凿的洞转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle the hole you cut, twice.

lines.zh: 你手里有鱼线，我认得。
lines.en: There is a fishing line in your hand; I know it.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你的腿还粗。
lines.en: My body is thicker than your leg.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在冰上，蓝得发暗。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the ice, dark blue.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只怕钩子。
lines.en: I do not fear you, only the hook.

lines.zh: 我浮到洞口，让你看个够。
lines.en: I rise to the hole and let you look your fill.

lines.zh: 冰水一下涌进伤口，疼得清楚。
lines.en: Icy water floods the wound, and the pain is clear.

lines.zh: 我猛地一甩尾，撞到冰底。
lines.en: I lash my tail and strike the ice above.

lines.zh: 血在冰水里散得又慢又淡。
lines.en: My blood thins out slowly through the freezing water.

lines.zh: 同伴退开了，我理解它。
lines.en: My companion backs away, and I understand.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我翻了个身。
lines.en: That blow rolled me onto my side.

lines.zh: 我往深处沉，冷能止疼。
lines.en: I sink deeper; the cold dulls the pain.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破了一角，划水变钝。
lines.en: A corner of my fin is torn and my stroke dulls.

lines.zh: 谁伤的我？我会记住方向。
lines.en: Who wounded me? I will remember the direction.

lines.zh: 我喘得急，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I gulp hard, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 血的味道把别的鱼引来了。
lines.en: The smell of blood draws other fish near.

lines.zh: 那是鱼饵吗？在冷水里晃。
lines.en: Is that bait, swaying in the cold water?

lines.zh: 我看到银色的东西在动。
lines.en: I see something silver moving.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，这味道太明显。
lines.en: I have been hungry long; this smell is obvious.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，鳍不敢乱动。
lines.en: I ease closer, keeping my fins still.

lines.zh: 同伴在后面，我叫它别来。
lines.en: My companion is behind; I warn it to stay back.

lines.zh: 有钩子的味道，我犹豫了。
lines.en: There is the smell of a hook, and I hesitate.

lines.zh: 张嘴一半，我又把它合上。
lines.en: Halfway open, my mouth closes again.

lines.zh: 这一口值不值得一条命？
lines.en: Is this one mouthful worth my life?

lines.zh: 我又绕回来了，谁让我饿。
lines.en: I have circled back; hunger made me.

lines.zh: 我用鳍尖碰了碰那东西。
lines.en: I touch the thing with the tip of a fin.

lines.zh: 冰太低了，我的背撞上了。
lines.en: The ice is too low and my back strikes it.

lines.zh: 同伴撞我，我们翻成一团。
lines.en: My companion rams me and we tumble as one.

lines.zh: 冰块漂过来，我顶开它。
lines.en: A floe drifts in and I shoulder it aside.

lines.zh: 你踩在冰上，我撞了冰底。
lines.en: You step on the ice and I hit its underside.

lines.zh: 我的鳍撞到石头，顿了一下。
lines.en: My fin strikes stone and I jolt.

lines.zh: 冰块碎开，白屑落了我一身。
lines.en: The ice shatters and white chips rain on me.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，只是冰太硬。
lines.en: That was not heavy; the ice is just hard.

lines.zh: 我被撞得横过来，又扳直了。
lines.en: I am knocked broadside and straighten myself.

lines.zh: 谁在水里挤我？这里没多宽。
lines.en: Who is crowding me? There is little room.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾，把痛甩掉。
lines.en: I flick my tail and shake off the ache.

lines.zh: 我们两条在冰下并排游。
lines.en: The two of us swim side by side under the ice.

lines.zh: 它的鳍比我白，像雪。
lines.en: Its fins are whiter than mine, like snow.

lines.zh: 冰水里，我们挨着彼此取暖。
lines.en: In the icy water we press together for warmth.

lines.zh: 冰缘的水流平稳，可以在那产卵。
lines.en: The current at the ice edge is calm; spawn there.

lines.zh: 我用身体侧面蹭了蹭它。
lines.en: I brush its side with my own flank.

lines.zh: 它摆尾，我就跟着摆。
lines.en: It beats its tail, so I beat mine.

lines.zh: 这一带以后会有很多小鱼。
lines.en: These waters will hold many small tuna later.

lines.zh: 我们绕着冰柱转了很久。
lines.en: We circle the ice pillar for a long while.

lines.zh: 它暖得让我意外。
lines.en: Its warmth surprises me.

lines.zh: 冷洋里，两条比一条好。
lines.en: In a cold sea, two are better than one.

lines.zh: 你把我抱起来，冰水全滴下去。
lines.en: You lift me and the icy water drains off.

lines.zh: 我的身体太沉，你的手在抖。
lines.en: I am heavy, and your hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 空气冻得我的鳃发疼。
lines.en: The air freezes my gills into aching.

lines.zh: 别把我放在雪上，太凉了。
lines.en: Do not lay me on the snow; it is too cold.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到你的体温，很陌生。
lines.en: I feel your body heat, and it is strange.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下尾，差点滑掉。
lines.en: I flick my tail and nearly slip free.

lines.zh: 桶里的水最好也是冰的。
lines.en: The bucket water had better be icy too.

lines.zh: 我在你手臂上留下一片湿。
lines.en: I leave a wet patch on your arms.

lines.zh: 你要把我搬到哪片冻洋？
lines.en: Which frozen sea are you carrying me to?

lines.zh: 放我进水里，我才会喘气。
lines.en: Only in water will I breathe again.

lines.zh: 冰下有一群鱼，动得很急。
lines.en: A shoal moves urgently beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 那股味道是油，是活的。
lines.en: That smell is oil, and it is alive.

lines.zh: 我的胸鳍早就立了起来。
lines.en: My pectoral fins have been raised for a while.

lines.zh: 同伴看我一眼，跟我一起转。
lines.en: My companion glances at me and turns along.

lines.zh: 我把身体对准冰缘的方向。
lines.en: I aim my body toward the ice edge.

lines.zh: 冷水里有东西在跑，很快。
lines.en: Something flees through the cold water, fast.

lines.zh: 我听见尾摆声，密密的。
lines.en: I hear tail beats, dense and quick.

lines.zh: 这一群够我们吃很久。
lines.en: This shoal could feed us for a long time.

lines.zh: 我一动，水就先让开。
lines.en: When I move, the water gives way first.

lines.zh: 目标在前面，我加速了。
lines.en: The target is ahead and I have sped up.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰底追，压低身体。
lines.en: I chase along the ice bottom, body pressed low.

lines.zh: 鱼群散开，我挑了最小的。
lines.en: The shoal scatters and I pick the smallest.

lines.zh: 它一头扎向深处，我追下去。
lines.en: It plunges for the depths and I chase below.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一直对着它。
lines.en: My fins stay pointed at it the whole time.

lines.zh: 冷水让我的动作更利落。
lines.en: The cold water makes my movements cleaner.

lines.zh: 它绕冰柱转，我也想绕。
lines.en: It rounds an ice pillar and I mean to as well.

lines.zh: 我能听见它的心跳，乱得很。
lines.en: I can hear its heartbeat, badly rattled.

lines.zh: 距离缩短到两个身位。
lines.en: The gap closes to two body lengths.

lines.zh: 冰面开裂了，光晃了一下。
lines.en: The ice cracks and the light flickers once.

lines.zh: 我张开口，冷水灌进来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and cold water rushes in.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，把水撞出一道白。
lines.en: I charge and leave a white scar in the water.

lines.zh: 一口咬住，牙齿陷进肉里。
lines.en: One bite lands and my teeth sink into flesh.

lines.zh: 它甩尾打我脸，我没松。
lines.en: It slaps my face with its tail; I do not let go.

lines.zh: 冰下翻起一团血雾。
lines.en: A cloud of blood blooms beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我的身体太重，撞一下就够。
lines.en: My body is heavy; one ram is enough.

lines.zh: 它想钻冰缝，我堵住了。
lines.en: It tries an ice crack and I block it.

lines.zh: 冷水中，我的动作比它快。
lines.en: In cold water I am faster than it is.

lines.zh: 这一下咬偏了，鳞飞了几片。
lines.en: This bite slips and a few scales fly.

lines.zh: 它挣扎着，我又咬住第二处。
lines.en: It fights on, so I sink my teeth somewhere else.

lines.zh: 血把周围的冰水都暖了。
lines.en: The blood warms the icy water around us.

lines.zh: 我在冰下的冻洋里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the frozen sea under ice.

lines.zh: 水冷得像刀，我却觉得刚好。
lines.en: The water cuts like a blade, and it suits me.

lines.zh: 头顶全是白的，那是冰。
lines.en: Everything overhead is white, and that is ice.

lines.zh: 这里没有同伴，我开始找。
lines.en: No companion here, so I begin searching.

lines.zh: 我闻到了另一条金枪鱼的味道。
lines.en: I catch the scent of another tuna.

lines.zh: 有人把我放进这片冷水里。
lines.en: Someone set me into this cold water.

lines.zh: 我的鳍第一次张开，划破水下的静。
lines.en: My fins spread for the first time, splitting the hush.

lines.zh: 这片冻洋很大，我慢慢走。
lines.en: This frozen sea is vast, and I take my time.

lines.zh: 冰缘有鱼，我先去那边。
lines.en: Fish keep to the ice edge; I head there first.

lines.zh: 冷是这里的规矩，我守。
lines.en: Cold is the rule here, and I keep it.

lines.zh: 冰水上面在烧，我不敢上去。
lines.en: Fire burns above the ice water; I keep below.

lines.zh: 我被抛上冰面，砸得很实。
lines.en: I am tossed onto the ice and land hard.

lines.zh: 我在水里，怎么会溺水？
lines.en: I am in water; how can I be drowning?

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我推到冰上。
lines.en: The blast shoves me up against the ice.

lines.zh: 一支箭划过冷水，扎进我的背。
lines.en: An arrow cuts the cold water into my back.

lines.zh: 冷水挡不住那股东西，它进了我的骨。
lines.en: The cold does not stop it; it enters my bones.

lines.zh: 冻洋里没吃的，我的肚子在叫。
lines.en: The frozen sea is empty and my belly complains.

lines.zh: 闪电劈在冰面，水底一片惨白。
lines.en: Lightning cracks the ice sheet and the seabed goes white.

lines.zh: 冰底裂开了，我掉进没有水的地方。
lines.en: The seafloor splits and I fall where no water is.
